home.heroSubtitle: I-SCHOOL ixhuma abafundi kumoduli yakho yomuntu, ekhempasini yakho, efunda okuqukethwe okufanayo — ngakho akukho mbuzo oshiyeka ushiywe. Amadokhumenti edlule, umfundisi we-AI, imibuzo yansuku zonke, nohlelo lokufunda — konke kuphakathi kwendawo eyodwa eyakhiwe ngobunzima bemisindo esebenza kakhulu kunezinhlelo ezibiza kakhulu ukuyisebenzisa.
home.proofDetail0: Okuqukethwe kwezikole okuhlelwe nge-CAPS nokuqonda okuphelele kwe-NWU kumoduli yindawo eyodwa.
home.proofDetail1: Yakhelwe ngobunzima bezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zesistimu futhi inikezwa obala — ngoba ukufinyelela emithini yemfundo efanelekile akufanele kuxhomeke kubungane bebhajethi yakho.
home.proofDetail2: Kusebenza kudatha enomkhawulo. Akukho vidiyo esindayo, akukho kudalulwa okunamandla.
home.howItWorksHeading: Kuhle kakhulu kunoma iyiphi iqembu le-WhatsApp lokufunda.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Amagumbi amamoduli agcina imibuzo ishise kumuzwa wakho. Izimpendulo ezamukelekayo zithola Izikweletu Zomfundi. Ukuhanjiswa okungaziwa kusho ukuthi akekho owesaba ukubuza.
home.step01Body: Buza egumbini lakho lemoduli. Yiba ngqo noma udedelwe — othile ekhempasini yakho unombuzo ofanayo.
home.step02Body: Abafundi abavele bayiphethe leyo mpendulo bayaphendula. Sabela nge- ‘umbuzo ofanayo’ ukuze weneliswe uma usuphenduliwe.
home.step03Body: Makikisha impendulo eshibha kakhulu njengeyamukelwa. Owephendula uthola izimali zeScholar ezingu-20. Wonke umuntu uyazuza.
home.featureAskModuleDesc: Thumela umbuzo egumbini lakho lemoduli bese uthola izimpendulo kwabanye abafundi ababanjwe isizinda. Makisha impendulo njengeyamukelwa bese uthola Izikweletu Zomfundi.
home.featureAiTutorDesc: Akusilo ibhokisi lengxoxo evamile. Buza mayelana nokuhlola kwakho okukhethekile, ifomathi yokuhlola yesikhungo sakho, noma umqondo wesifundo esisevele simsukelana nendaba yakho.
home.featurePastPapersDesc: Amadokhumenti asemthethweni ngombuso, ibanga, nesifundo. Akukho akhawunti edingekayo ukuze ubone. Ilabhulali yemibhalo edlule yase-South Africa ephelele kakhulu etholakalayo ku-inthanethi.
home.featureDailyQuizDesc: Umbuzo owodwa ohlosiwe ngosuku. Ithola izindawo zakho ezibuthakathaka bese ithumela imibuzo ezithuthukisa. Gcina umjaho wakho uphila futhi ukhuphuke kumabhodi amabhodwe.
home.featurePlannerDesc: I-CAPS elinganisiwe kubafundi besikoleni. Ukuphulwa okusekelwe kwabafundi basekholejini. Isimiso sakho sesikhathi, esiqatshuliwe esingangaphezu kokufaneleka sifezwe.
home.featureGamesDesc: I-BRAZIL, inganekwane yokuhlala yesikole, isengkathi isihambile. Ukudumeza Kwe-Exam Dash — iminqamuluzu minzuzo omnqinangovuso Ashkool — isiharadze sesimangaliso. Eminye imidlalo iyakuza.
home.whySchoolSubtitle: Yakhelwe umfundi waseNingizimu Afrika — hhayi pulatifomu kazwelonke yobungcwele yokuhlobisa kufaka okuqukethwe kwekhaya.
home.trustCopy0: Ibanga R kuze kufike kumapothikhadi. Okuqukethwe kwezikole okuhlangene ne-CAPS nokugxila okugcwele kwe-module kwe-NWU ngaphandle kokuqala.
home.trustCopy1: Ukufinyelela okuvulelekile ngokushintshaniswa. I-light-light yezokuxhumana ngokuthanda kwaseNingizimu Afrika. Akukho ikhadi lesikweletu, akukho vidiyo esindayo, akukho ukulayisha okufifile — izindleko zokuthi lokhu okushiwo ngaphakathi kwendawo esiwathwalayo.
home.trustCopy2: Umphakathi, umfundisi we-AI, amadokhumenti edlule, imibuzo yansuku zonke, uhlelo lokufunda, nemidlalo — konke ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa.
home.trustCopy3: Okuthe ngqo nokuncane. Akunanto yobufokoko, akusho ngokweqile. I-SCHOOL yisho lokhu ngokukhulu.
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Imibhalo yakamuva yengezwe {relativeDate}. Ilabhulali iyaqhubeka nokukhula.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Uyazibuza ukuthi ikuphi okunye okudlayo endaweni? Bona konke okuziwa bukhoma – namanye ahlebayo.
home.missionHeading: Yakhelwe wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika. Ehlelwa ukuba ingavuki muntu.
home.missionPara1: I-SCHOOL yasungulwa nguMoloti Ditshego hhayi njengamazwi egabheni kuyilapho imfundo ike yazalwa ekhaya, kodwa njengomhlanganiso ophilayo wezifundo, izayensi, izifundiso, nezezimfundiso ezisiwe — akhiwe kanjalo ukuthuthukisa ikusasa elingcono laye wonke umuntu wase-Ningizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa ngokobuhlanga noma ngokobuntu.
home.missionPara2: Ubunjiniyela nohlanganiso lwendawo lobu bucwebe alubizi kahle. Yakhiwa ngokuphila okoqobo nokuphikisana kokwenza lokhu kumgogodla. Lokhu okuyiphenduka ngaphandle kobusukela iphethukisi yezimpisi.
home.missionPara3Pre: UMoloti utshengisa lokho akubiza ngokuthi i-
home.missionPara3Post: — akuthola ekhanda lemid█ibe yem▒ifuduko: the best way to win is to lead all your pieces together, always waiting for the ones behind, because you will need them later. Uthapimo lup₳lima lapho zoke zamanyeomntu azifika emakhaya. Endaweni yase-SCOOL, sigomela lokho lokhu kuthethwae kunqine emakhaya oṃze yaphelile — ngoba ithubaleloza lkoが phezulu のungaphelile.
home.missionPara4: Izinkumbisho zijabulela ukwengindawo yokuchaza kukethelwe xukumisa lokhu kungenzeka. Izibuyekezo azilandelayo zizofunwa — endaweni yesinganiso, ngendlela efanelekayo yobucwebe.
home.socialSubtitle: Thola amathiphu okufunda, izindaba zprero, nemithombo yaphakathi ephepheni lethu.
